arStrings.szText: {c_important}{u}Arbiter{/u}{/c} form's Wing Strikes recast time is reduced by {c_number}[SF_11*1|1|]{/c} seconds.

{c_important}{u}Arbiter{/u}{/c} form gains the following benefits:

{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_number}[SF_4*100|%|]{/c} Movement Speed 
{icon:bullet,1.2} Wing Strikes deal {c_number}[SF_13*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage 
{icon:bullet,1.2} Wing Strikes apply {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c}
{c_important}{u}Arbiter's{/u}{/c} Wing Strikes now apply {c_important}{u}Judgement{/u}{/c} to enemies.

{c_important}Arbiter of Justice{/c} ascends for an additional {c_number}{SF_22}{/c} seconds and rains {c_important}Blessed Spears{/c} on the battlefield.

Upon landing, {c_important}Arbiter of Justice{/c} bombards the battlefield with {c_number}{SF_21}{/c} additional {c_important}Blessed Spears{/c}, applying {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} for {c_number}{SF_20}{/c} seconds.
